name: Wassail
description: A warm and spicy apple cider drink perfect for the holiday season, flavored with lemon, cinnamon, and pineapple juice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, heat the apple cider and cinnamon stick to boiling.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in nutmeg, honey, lemon juice, lemon peel, and pineapple juice.
Simmer, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot in mugs and garnish with cinnamon sticks.

keywords: wassail, apple cider drink, holiday beverage, spiced drink

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple with Chicken and Ginger
_similar.description: A classic sweet and sour dish featuring parboiled chicken legs in a tangy pineapple and ginger sauce, served over fried rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and separate chicken legs at the joint. Parboil for 15 to 20 minutes to remove excess fat.
Saute onions and celery in vegetable oil until tender. Add drained mushrooms and cook briefly.
Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in hot water. Add soya sauce, ginger, salt, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch with cold water until smooth. Pour into boiling sauce and stir frequently until thickened.
Add drained pineapple to the sauce. Adjust seasoning with pineapple juice if desired.
Lay parboiled chicken pieces in a greased casserole dish. Pour sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve over Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, ginger sauce

_similar.name: Orange-Pineapple Jello
_similar.description: A fruity Jello dessert with orange, pineapple, and nuts.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

recipeInstructions.text: Drain pineapple and reserve syrup. Add water to make ¾ cup.
Heat the liquid to boiling.
Place Jello in a bowl and add hot liquid, pineapple, and orange juice concentrate.
Chill until thickish.
Fold in Dream Whip along with marshmallows and pecans.

_similar.name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

_similar.keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Plain Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: A simple recipe for pickled eggs with a tangy cider vinegar brine and sliced onions.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except eggs and onion rings in a stainless steel or enamel pot.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large jar, alternate layers of eggs and onion rings.
Pour the heated liquid over the eggs and onions, ensuring all are covered.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Will keep in the fridge for 2 weeks.
